text.p: Hurricane Warnings from Punta San Telmo to San Blas including the Islas Marias along the southwest Mexico coast. Tropical Storm Warnings and a Hurricane Watch from north of San Blas to Mazatlan.

Hurricane Hernan is currently centered off the southwest coast of Japan 20 miles west northwest of Manzanillo, moving northwest at 9 mph, and is expected to continue this motion today, as top winds remain near 75 mph.
Rainfall of 5-10 inches, higher in the mountains, will occur with this storm, producing life-threatening flash floods and mudslides. Storm surge waves of 3-5 feet are expected.

Typhoon Zane is only a threat to shipping about 600 miles southeast of Japan at this time. The storm is moving rapidly east at 30 mph and has top winds near 75 mph, which will weaken as the storm moves out to sea and becomes extratropical.

Disturbed weather in the western Gulf of Mexico is of some concern to shipping. Gusty winds and rough seas may cause a few minor problems. This area is being watched as it may develop to a tropical depression this period.
